lead: `lower_first_method` lowers `T`'s *first* method, so a lowering fixture puts the method under test first and its helpers after it.
body: Declaring the callee at the top, `.nvst`-style, snapshots the callee's own body — a `safepoint`, a `param` per declaration and a `return` — which reads as a lowering that produced nothing rather than as the wrong function. Reorder the two members.
